nodes.label: eProcScraper/backend/requirements.txt
nodes.rationale: Fully pinned dependency set targeting python:3.12-slim Docker image; deviations from the host Python 3.13 freeze were required to satisfy mitmproxy 12.x typing-extensions cap and FastAPI/starlette version bounds.

nodes.label: pydantic 2.11.4
nodes.rationale: Pinned to 2.11.4 instead of 2.12.5 because pydantic 2.12.5 requires typing-extensions>=4.14.1, which mitmproxy 12.x forbids on Python<3.13; pydantic 2.11.4 permits typing-extensions 4.14.

nodes.label: selenium 4.36.0
nodes.rationale: Downgraded to 4.36.0 because selenium 4.37+ requires typing-extensions>=4.15, conflicting with the mitmproxy-imposed 4.14 cap on Python<3.13.

nodes.label: sse-starlette 3.0.3
nodes.rationale: Pinned to 3.0.3 because sse-starlette 3.2.x requires starlette>=0.49.1, while fastapi 0.118 requires starlette<0.49.

nodes.label: typing-extensions 4.14.0
nodes.rationale: Held at 4.14.0 because mitmproxy 12.x caps typing-extensions at <=4.14 on Python<3.13.
